description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewDao class, which manages database operations related to performance reviews within the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting performance review records, as well as handling associated entities such as reviewers, reviewer ratings, and filters for querying performance reviews.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling performance review related database operations in the OrangeHRM performance module.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees supervised by a specific employee based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorCount
methods.description: Counts the number of supervised employees matching the specified filter criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query to fetch employee-supervisor relationships based on filter parameters.

methods.name: createReview
methods.description: Creates a new performance review record, including associated reviewers, within a database transaction.

methods.name: saveReviewer
methods.description: Saves a reviewer entity linked to a performance review, setting appropriate group and status.

methods.name: saveReviewerRating
methods.description: Saves reviewer ratings for a performance review, associated KPIs, and reviewer entities.

methods.name: getEditableReviewById
methods.description: Retrieves a performance review by ID if it is inactive and editable.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewById
methods.description: Fetches a performance review by its ID.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewList
methods.description: Fetches a list of performance reviews based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewCount
methods.description: Counts the number of performance reviews matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a query for retrieving performance reviews with applied filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getPerformanceSelfReviewStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of a self-review process for a given performance review.

methods.name: updateReview
methods.description: Updates an existing performance review and its reviewers within a transaction.

methods.name: deletePerformanceReviewReviewers
methods.description: Deletes reviewer records associated with a specific performance review.

methods.name: getSupervisorRecord
methods.description: Fetches supervisor-report relationships between subordinate and supervisor IDs.

methods.name: getReviewKPI
methods.description: Retrieves KPIs associated with a specific performance review.

methods.name: getPerformanceSelfReviewer
methods.description: Obtains the reviewer record that is the employee's own self-reviewer for a given performance review.

methods.name: deletePerformanceReviews
methods.description: Deletes multiple performance reviews by their IDs.

methods.name: getReviewById
methods.description: Retrieves a performance review entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceReviewIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of performance reviews that exist from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getKpisForReview
methods.description: Retrieves KPIs relevant for a specific review based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getKpisForReviewCount
methods.description: Counts KPIs relevant for a specific review based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getKpisForReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds query to fetch KPIs for review with filters and sorting.

methods.name: savePerformanceReview
methods.description: Persists a performance review entity to the database.

methods.name: setReviewerStatusToCompleted
methods.description: Sets all reviewers' status to 'completed' for a given review ID.

methods.name: getReviewIdsForSupervisorReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves review IDs associated with a supervisor under specific criteria.

methods.name: getPurgeEmployeeReviewIds
methods.description: Returns a list of performance review IDs linked to employee records that are purged.

methods.name: getReviewIdList
methods.description: Fetches a list of active performance review IDs.

methods.name: getSelfReviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves self-review IDs for an employee, filtered by optional statuses.

methods.name: getReviewerRating
methods.description: Gets reviewer ratings and comments for a supervisor evaluation based on filters.

methods.name: getReviewerRatingCount
methods.description: Counts reviewer ratings based on evaluation filters.

methods.name: getEvaluationRatingQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs query for reviewer ratings for evaluations with filters.

methods.name: getKpiIdsForReviewId
methods.description: Fetches KPI IDs associated with a specific review ID.

methods.name: getKpiIdsForJobTitleId
methods.description: Fetches KPI IDs associated with a specific job title.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateReviewerRatings
methods.description: Saves or updates a list of reviewer ratings in bulk.

methods.name: getReviewerRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a reviewer record for a review ID and group.

methods.name: updateReviewerStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of reviewers for a specific performance review and group.

methods.name: updateReviewerComment
methods.description: Updates the comment provided by a reviewer for a performance review.
